headline: Golden Disc Awards reveal 41st nominees
sub: BTS, Stray Kids, aespa and more up for Bonsang in Hanoi

info.title: At a glance
rows: Sung Si Kyung, Mun Ka Young

points.title: Who's in
items: Digital: BTS, IVE, aespa, ATEEZ, ILLIT, NMIXX
Album: BTS, Stray Kids, ENHYPEN, TXT, RIIZE, EXO
Rookies include ALPHA DRIVE ONE, LNGSHOT
Covers releases from Nov 2025 to Oct 2026

source: Source: 41st Golden Disc Awards organizing committee
caption:
The 41st Golden Disc Awards have announced their nominees!

Twenty acts are up for the Digital Song Bonsang, 20 for the Album Bonsang and 15 for Rookie Artist of the Year. Nominees include BTS, Stray Kids, ENHYPEN, TXT, RIIZE, aespa, IVE and ATEEZ. The ceremony runs Jan 9–10, 2027 at VEC in Hanoi, Vietnam, hosted by Sung Si Kyung and Mun Ka Young. Eligible releases came out between early Nov 2025 and late Oct 2026.

📌 Source: Golden Disc Awards organizing committee, via Korean media
